text:
Investigate this suspected problem.

Suspect S1: Use of standard equality operator instead of constant-time comparison
Category: security
Location: src/werkzeug/security.py lines 146-146 (new version)
Suspected problem: Replacing hmac.compare_digest with a standard string comparison (==) exposes the application to timing attacks when verifying password hashes, even if the lengths are supposedly the same.
What would confirm or refute it: Check the surrounding password hashing implementations and tests in the repository to ensure constant-time guarantees are expected and whether hashval could ever differ in length or type under certain conditions.

arguments.explanation: In src/werkzeug/security.py, check_password_hash compares the computed password hash with the stored hashval using standard string equality (==) rather than hmac.compare_digest. Standard string comparison short-circuits on the first mismatching character, leaking timing information that can be exploited by attackers to recover password hashes.
